title: Procedural crystal cluster (Python (trimesh + numpy))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Python (trimesh + numpy) that procedurally generates: Generate a cluster of 5-10 elongated bipyramid ('double cone') crystal shapes, each with a hexagonal or square cross-section, at seeded-random orientations, positions, and lengths, clustered around a common base point without full overlap at the origin. Save to glb, obj with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
